name: How long does it take to install a new door?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to install a new door can vary depending on the type of door and the complexity of the installation. A standard interior door replacement might take a few hours, while an exterior door, especially if it requires frame modifications or new hardware, could take a full day. Custom doors or those with intricate designs may require more time for precise fitting and finishing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies; standard interior doors take a few hours, while exterior or custom doors can take a full day or more.
